reply.text:
I'll pull your recent training and lifts to answer this from what you've logged. Nothing is logged in the app for the last 12 weeks, so I can't check your loads or trends. I can only answer in general terms.

Eight weeks of hard training is right around when a deload usually makes sense, especially if you're feeling any of this: weights that used to move well are stalling or dropping, your sleep is worse, your motivation is flat, or you're dreading sessions you normally like. If most of those are true, take a lighter week. If you feel good and your lifts are still climbing, you can keep going and plan a deload for when that changes.

A deload isn't time off. A common approach is to keep your usual sessions but cut the sets by about a third to a half and leave a few more reps in the tank on every set.

How have the last couple of weeks felt, and are your main lifts still moving up? If you want a lighter session built for you, tell me and I'll set it up.
